author: packs
description: D24-T3: the whole ISIC Rev.4 list, 21 sections, 88 divisions, 238 groups and 419 classes, each under its parent. English labels from the UN Statistics Division structure file; Arabic labels from the UN Arabic edition (ST/ESA/STAT/SER.M/4/Rev.4). Sections and divisions (0003, 0011) are upserted again with the UN Arabic text.
